question: The long term objective of National Population Policy (NFP) 2000 is to achieve a stable population by _____ with sustainable economic growth, social development and environmental protection.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2045.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Population Policy (NFP) 2000** aims to achieve a **stable population** by **2045.**
 
• The policy focuses on **sustainable economic growth, social development, and environmental protection.**
 
• The stable population would mean that the** population growth rate **would be** zero,** and the population would remain constant. 
 
• The policy aims to achieve this through various measures like promoting **family planning,** improving **health and education facilities,** and creating **employment opportunities.**
 
• The policy aims to ensure that the population growth rate **does not **exceed the carrying capacity of the environment.
